['①. Red Signal Orb: Grants a brief <color=#0E70BD>speed boost</color> when picked up.', '②. Yellow Orb: Grants temporary <color=#0E70BD>debuff immunity</color> when picked up.', '③. ['①. Spend a specified number of <color=#0E70BD>Black Gold Bear Cards</color> to unlock stages.']

['①. <color=#0E70BD>Press and hold</color> an icon, then drag to <color=#0E70BD>connect two identical icons</color>. Once connected, all the <color=#0E70BD>blocks</color> along the path will be <color=#0E70BD>lit up</color>.']
['①. When both the <color=#0E70BD>number of connected icons</color> and the <color=#0E70BD>number of blocks lit up</color> reach the target, you can claim the clear reward.']

['①. Connecting Lines: A new line can <color=#0E70BD>overwrite</color> an already connected line. Use "Reset" to <color=#0E70BD>reset</color> all the connected icons in the current stage.', "②. Hollow Tiles: You can't connect lines across Hollow Tiles. Try going around them."]

['①. The Godfall Revelation includes two modes: <color=#0E70BD>Story Mode - Path of Revelation and Matchmaking Mode - Desperado Clash</color>. Path of Revelation lets you experience the full story, while Desperado Clash pits you against other Commandants.']
['①. Choose a character to explore their story and <color=#0E70BD>advance their unique path</color>.']
['①. In Path of Revelation mode, <color=#0E70BD>uncover clues through various events</color> to progress the story.']
['①. After collecting enough clues, you can <color=#0E70BD>begin calculation</color>.']
['①. <color=#0E70BD>Select the correct clues</color> based on the questions and advance the story simulation step by step.']

['①. Tap here to select a character for this challenge.', '②. In Desperado Clash mode, each character has independent points. Win battles to earn points, <color=#0E70BD>raise your rank</color>, and claim <color=#0E70BD>Honor Rewards</color>.', '③. You may freely use the story-themed Coatings during gameplay.']

['①. Desperado Clash requires consecutive battles. Each victory grants 1 badge; collect <color=#0E70BD>10 badges</color> to <color=#0E70BD>complete the challenge</color>. Each defeat costs 1 HP. When <color=#0E70BD>HP runs out</color>, the challenge <color=#0E70BD>ends early</color> and point rewards are tallied.', '②. Here on the right side are the skill slots. Equip selected skills to use them in battle.', '③. <color=#0E70BD>Before each battle</color>, characters can enter the Mysterious Tavern for <color=#0E70BD>battle preparation</color>. ["①. In Mysterious Tavern, you can spend<color=#0E70BD> gold to purchase Runes</color>. Runes enhance a character's base stats and grant them <color=#0E70BD>special abilities</color>. As the battles progress, the quantity and rarity of Runes available in Mysterious Tavern will gradually improve.", '②. Rune slots are at the center. Equip purchased Runes there to activate them in battle.', '③. <color=#0E70BD>Spend coins to unlock</color> additional Rune <color=#0E70BD>slots</color>. The cost decreases each round, down to a minimum of 1 coin.', '④. Refresh to instantly update the items in the tavern. Use "Freeze" to prevent selected items from being refreshed.']

['①. Skills and Runes are labeled with <color=#0E70BD>tags</color> for clarity, which includes 5 <color=#0E70BD>attribute tags</color> and 7 <color=#0E70BD>archetype tags</color>. Runes bearing attribute tags can boost their respective <color=#0E70BD>attributes</color> when certain battle conditions are fulfilled.']

['①. In The Godfall Revelation, there are 7 <color=#0E70BD>main archetypes</color> of Runes, plus a few without a defined archetype. Runes with the same <color=#0E70BD>archetype tag</color> share similar <color=#0E70BD>combat styles</color>.']

['①. In The Godfall Revelation, characters engage in fully automated one-on-one battles using their equipped skills and Runes. The side whose HP drops to zero first loses the battle.', '②. <color=#0E70BD>30 seconds</color> into the battle, <color=#0E70BD>Death Speed</color> begins. Both sides continuously lose HP until one is defeated.', '③. During battle, the sides of the screen show the <color=#0E70BD>skills</color> used by each side, while the bottom shows the <color=#0E70BD>Runes</color> triggered by each side.']

['①. <color=#0E70BD>Level</color> up to gain <color=#0E70BD>ATK</color> and <color=#0E70BD>HP</color>.', '②. Unlock <color=#0E70BD>accessories</color> at specific levels to enhance combat power or economic profits.']
['①. <color=#0E70BD>Alchemy Hammer</color> can enhance 5★ Runes, further improving their combat power.']

['①. Upon accepting a commission, you can view its <color=#0E70BD>completion conditions</color> and associated <color=#0E70BD>Blessings</color>, including their strength at each rank and the cost to rank up.', "②. Tap the <color=#0E70BD>Refresh</color> button to replace a commission you don't want. This can be done only once per slot."]

['①. After a commission is accepted, the <color=#0E70BD>commission progress</color> is displayed above. Tap Blessing to review <color=#0E70BD>commission details</color>. ['①. Bubble Block: Merge it to the target size to increase the Dream Depth and clear the board.', '②. Dormant Wavelength: The size your Bubble Block needs to reach to trigger an upgrade.']

['①. Clearing Pattern: The <color=#0E70BD>arrow direction</color> on a Bubble Block shows which rows or columns will be cleared. For example, if the arrows point up, left, and right, all blocks above and on the same row will be cleared.']

["①. When a block has a <color=#0E70BD>border</color>, it means it's currently within the clearing area.", "②. When a block's number is too small, upgrading it will <color=#0E70BD>turn it into a Stone Block</color>.", '③. Dream Depth: Increases by 1 after each clear.']

['①. Moves Left: Normal Stages have limited moves, but Infinite Stages let you play freely.', '②. Special blocks that will appear in the current level. Tap to view details.', '④. When the board level maxes out, Normal Stages will automatically complete.']

['①. Score: Earn points whenever you clear or merge blocks.', '②. Dream Level: Shows how close you are to the target Dream Level based on your score.', '③. Reach the target Dream Level to finish early.']

['①. Cool Block: Can merge with numbered blocks. When merged with a Hot Block, it randomly keeps one element.', '②. Hot Block: Can merge with numbered blocks. ['①. Spend <color=#0E70BD>Whalesound Memory</color> to flip cards. <color=#0E70BD>Whalesound Memory</color> can be obtained through event missions.']
['①. Flip cards that meet the requirements at the same time to <color=#0E70BD>clear</color> them.', '②. Each stage has different <color=#0E70BD>clear requirements</color>.']

['①. After flipping a certain number of cards, you can continue flipping cards in the current stage without consuming <color=#0E70BD>Whalesound Memory</color>.']
['①. Clear a specified number of cards in the stage to claim the corresponding rewards.']
['①. Rapid Pursuit has four stages, and each stage offers four difficulty levels.']

['①. Clearing stages has a <color=#0E70BD>chance to drop collectibles</color>, which are shown in real time on the details page. After it ends, the items will be lost and your <color=#0E70BD>chance of obtaining rare collectibles</color> will increase.']

['①. Whether it is a battle or a dispatch, you will <color=#0E70BD>contribute</color> to the server <color=#0E70BD>clearing progress</color>. Consume <color=#0E70BD>Floating Processors</color> to perform <color=#0E70BD>dispatches</color> or join <color=#0E70BD>battles</color> to earn <color=#0E70BD>Contribution, tokens, and random collectibles</color>. <color=#0E70BD>Higher battle ratings</color> grant <color=#0E70BD>more Contribution and tokens</color>.']

['①. <color=#0E70BD>Floating Processors</color> <color=#0E70BD>replenish over time</color>, with a maximum storage capacity of 480.', '②. ['①. Tap a collectible to view its <color=#0E70BD>detailed information</color>.', '②. ['①. Tap to filter by <color=#0E70BD>collectible type</color>.', '②. Switch between <color=#0E70BD>purchasing and selling</color> here.', '③. Tap a collectible to <color=#0E70BD>purchase</color> it, which costs a certain amount of tokens.']

Tap a collectible to <color=#0E70BD>set price and quantity</color> and list it in the Auction House.']

['①. When selling collectibles, you can <color=#0E70BD>adjust the price and quantity</color> within a set range.', "②. This shows your <color=#0E70BD>expected income</color>. ['①. <color=#0E70BD>Consume 1 rare collectible</color> to unlock its entry in the codex and claim a <color=#0E70BD>one-time collection reward</color>.']

['①. When a block is <color=#0E70BD>cleared</color>, all Commandants on the server will receive its <color=#0E70BD>clear rewards</color>. Blocks of <color=#0E70BD>different types</color> offer <color=#0E70BD>different rewards</color> when cleared.']
['①. As the <color=#0E70BD>server progress</color> increases, more Battle Reports will be gradually <color=#0E70BD>unlocked</color> in the Battle Report Notice.']

["①. Once you get your <color=#0E70BD>Trial Prototypes</color> from <color=#0E70BD>solo</color> or <color=#0E70BD>server rewards</color>, don't forget to <color=#0E70BD>exchange for rewards</color> at Special Supplies. ['①.<color=#0E70BD>Every hour</color>, the tokens are tallied.The<color=#0E70BD>unclaimed</color> tokens will<color=#0E70BD> remain </color>until you claim them.', '②.Gain Trial Prototype tokens <color=#0E70BD>automatically</color> over time after <color=#0E70BD>the Dark blocks are cleared</color>.The more Dark Blocks cleared, the higher the hourly token yield is.']

['①. Movement Controls: <color=#0E70BD>Swipe or tap buttons to move your character. On PC, you can use the WASD keys.</color>', '②.
